mintAuthority.summary: USDCV is issued natively on Ethereum and Solana. Ethereum SmartCoin V4 minting is gated by the registrar EOA (0x7de0bb…da69), with no proxy admin and a technical EOA controlling UUPS upgrades; the Solana Token-2022 mint, freeze authority, permanent delegate, and metadata/update authority are all held by SG-FORGE key 5tg4qRdiXJ7XxYd6KK4UnnNvxgHJqfBUygPqZLwSnhnt.

controls.label: SG-FORGE issuance backend
controls.evidence: Per SG-FORGE materials, onboarded institutional investors buy USDCV 1:1 by sending USD to SG-FORGE's bank account; SG-FORGE mints tokens to investor wallet. On-chain, the registrar EOA (immutable) is the sole minter. Issuer-backend model corroborated: all role holders are SG-FORGE-operated EOAs.

controls.label: USDCV Ethereum token proxy (SmartCoin V4)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294784: EIP-1967 impl = 0xf4ccc80c4b831a0d8d1414f2aca82a3d760ff05b (same SmartCoin V4 as EURCV); proxy admin slot = zero. Immutable operators from implementation bytecode (PUSH32 scan): registrar (minter) = 0x7de0bbdfcd4a6a956f149befcca30d6b5bc5da69 (EOA), operations = 0xc98cb9f53e20afbbeb75caf6456ed52d5d7903f6 (EOA), technical (upgrade admin) = 0x54124a6834af252a0f9ac7f478001aa500428955 (EOA). All confirmed as EOAs via eth_getCode.

controls.label: USDCV SmartCoin technical upgrade EOA
controls.evidence: The verified SmartCoin V4 implementation exposes proxiableUUID(), upgradeTo(), and upgradeToAndCall(), and gates _authorizeUpgrade to the technical operator. At Ethereum block 25530874, technical() returned 0x54124a6834af252a0f9ac7f478001aa500428955; eth_getCode at that block returned no bytecode. The proxy's EIP-1967 admin slot is zero, so this EOA is the UUPS upgrade authority rather than a ProxyAdmin contract.

controls.label: SG-FORGE USDCV Solana Token-2022 authority
controls.evidence: At Solana slot 439713548, the official USDCV Token-2022 mint 8smindLdDuySY6i2bStQX9o8DVhALCXCMbNxD98unx35 returned decimals 2 and supply 198,938,000 base units. Its mintAuthority, freezeAuthority, and permanentDelegate all equal SG-FORGE key 5tg4qRdiXJ7XxYd6KK4UnnNvxgHJqfBUygPqZLwSnhnt; metadata/update authority also equals that key. The SG-FORGE operations metadata key is 4N1WwAaSukn7YtRKRArA3Ntp4CfcB1nCiqCDGEjEBhEj. This is native issuer control, not bridge authority. No Solana proxy-admin or upgrade path was established beyond the live Token-2022 authorities and SG-FORGE's primary source.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294784: USDCV and EURCV share implementation 0xf4ccc80c4b831a0d8d1414f2aca82a3d760ff05b (SmartCoin V4, UUPS). Proxy admin slot zero. Immutable operators extracted from bytecode: registrar/minter EOA 0x7de0bbdfcd4a6a956f149befcca30d6b5bc5da69, operations EOA 0xc98cb9f53e20afbbeb75caf6456ed52d5d7903f6, technical/upgrade EOA 0x54124a6834af252a0f9ac7f478001aa500428955. All EOAs confirmed. On-chain model corroborates SG-FORGE issuer-backend description. At Solana slot 439713548 on 2026-08-16, the official Token-2022 mint 8smindLdDuySY6i2bStQX9o8DVhALCXCMbNxD98unx35 returned SG-FORGE key 5tg4qRdiXJ7XxYd6KK4UnnNvxgHJqfBUygPqZLwSnhnt as mintAuthority, freezeAuthority, permanentDelegate, and metadata/update authority; no separate Solana upgrade path was inferred. USDCV is therefore native on both Ethereum and Solana, with chain-specific authorities. SG-FORGE publishes issuer-reported reserve composition and valuation daily, with the latest observed snapshot dated July 11, 2026, but challenge searches found no recurring independent USDCV assets-and-liabilities reconciliation or qualifying attestor. Reconciliation is therefore unknown. SG-FORGE's issuer disclosure identifies Société Générale-FORGE as the USDCV issuer and as an ACPR-authorized Electronic Money Institution; the ACPR register is the competent prudential registry, supporting prudential supervision of the same legal entity. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: the registrar and no-delay technical EOA, together with the Solana mint authority, leave issuance economically unbounded, ACPR supervises SG-FORGE as EMI, and daily issuer NAV data is not an independent whole-supply assets-and-liabilities attestation.
